selected_callback_chain.callback_to_output_flow: The callback's candidate-processing branch calls the candidate materializer, then the spatial-coding strategy dispatcher. Both callback branches converge on the same in-DLL metadata/bitstream output routine. The branch taken by run120 was not recorded.
selected_callback_chain.candidate_input_boundary: The materializer reads a count-indexed source-buffer pointer vector and copies feature data by local ordinal. The decompiled operation does not read a typed global candidate ID field.

post_weight_metadata_vector.consumer_action: The type-specific serializer reads each F32 array by local ordinal and copies its values into the output metadata block.

selected_callback_chain.stream_writer: The writer validates a common stream/object kind and dispatches type-specific serializers. Its per-source payload path uses float-array pointers and local ordinals; it does not join a candidate global ID to a source-weight column.
selected_callback_chain.byte_sink: The callback sink allocates an output byte range and copies the serialized bytes into the host-facing buffer.
selected_callback_chain.complete_in_dll_consumer_boundary: candidate input materialization -> local-ordinal selection/reassembly -> matrix-only scoring -> typed F32 metadata serialization -> output byte buffer

identity_conclusion.reason: No typed global candidate ID is read by the candidate materializer, passed to the source-weight helper, consulted by the selector reassembly consumer, or serialized in the observed per-source F32 metadata path. The graph-level owner of the source buffers is outside the target DLL boundary.

minimal_future_observer_design.required_host_edge: At the host-side ADM graph producer, capture the typed global ID (or an explicitly typed stable graph token) and the owner token for the source buffer passed to the DLL.
dll_side_edges: At candidate materialization, hash the count-indexed source-buffer pointer tokens and record destination-buffer owner tokens by local ordinal.
At selector and reassembly, record the explicit local-ordinal remap into each matrix column.
At source-weight entry, record the matrix owner token, column ordinals, source count, and weight-output vector hash.
At metadata serialization, record the typed F32-array owner tokens and local ordinals reaching the output byte buffer.
minimal_future_observer_design.generation_rule: Join records only within a typed owner generation captured from the host/graph producer and the same callback scope. A thread ID or callback sequence alone is a scope label, not a global generation identity.
minimal_future_observer_design.privacy_rule: Persist only field types, opaque owner-token digests, generation token, local ordinal/remap, column ordinal, dimensions, and hashes. Do not persist raw ADM records, raw pointer values, descriptor words, feature values, PCM, or serialized media.
minimal_future_observer_design.execution_blocker: The successful run120 directory is preserved. The C-drive run121 attempt failed before workflow construction, and Windows denied creation of a separate E-drive run directory before host launch.
